description: Picks one of the six Glass themes for the Show dashboard from sun elevation and the current weather. Replaces 'Show theme follows the sun'.

data.name: {% set el = state_attr('sun.sun','elevation')|float(0) %}{% set rising = state_attr('sun.sun','rising') %}{% set w = states('weather.forecast_home') %}{% if el < -6 %}Glass Night{% elif el < 8 %}{{ 'Glass Dawn' if rising else 'Glass Dusk' }}{% elif w in ['rainy','pouring','lightning','lightning-rainy','hail','snowy','snowy-rainy'] %}Glass Rain{% elif w in ['cloudy','fog','windy','windy-variant','exceptional'] %}Glass Cloudy{% else %}Glass Day{% endif %}
